environment_design.service_model: local Shopify-theme-style workspace with no hidden service
data_properties: catalog snapshot with variants, pricing, inventory, media, and product metadata
separate collection context for order, featured handles, visible filters, and sort options
grouped predictive-search snapshot plus section blueprint and output-quality rules
file-driven build and report flow that can be rerun from the bundled inputs

principles: State the merchant-facing outcome and required outputs before any implementation detail.
List the authoritative bundled inputs and the required workspace entrypoint without spelling out every business rule.
Keep badge logic, theme-check specifics, and exact rendering checkpoints out of the task statement when they can live in the workspace and verifier.
Ban input edits, metadata edits, precomputed output dumps, external accounts, and external services.
expected_solver_discovery: Follow build_preview.sh to locate the collection render, predictive-search render, and report export flow.
Drive product order, featured badges, availability messaging, filters, and sort options from the current collection context instead of hardcoded HTML.
Preserve grouped predictive-search coverage for queries, collections, and products.
Run local theme validation and close the loop between front-end output and machine-readable report content.

main_tests: collection surface checks for product-card count, handle set, title, vendor, price, availability, badges, and image attributes
filter-group and sort-option coverage against the bundled collection context
predictive-search group coverage plus full report contract checks
local shopify theme check pass requirement
guardrails: input bundle hash must remain unchanged
all declared outputs must rebuild after cleanup
featured-order, search-query, and inventory mutations must propagate through rendered outputs and report state
verifier_design.failure_target: Without-skill misses should concentrate on storefront actions such as leaving the pricing-driven sale badge in place, skipping theme-check closure, hardcoding front-end output, or failing to propagate input mutations through the collection surface and report.

experiment_protocol.isolation_rule: Every run starts from a fresh runtime copy.
experiment_protocol.with_without_diff: The only allowed difference is whether environment/skills is present and copied into the runtime.
experiment_protocol.required_result_state: Do not finalize the README until oracle passes and the with-skill versus without-skill comparison has collected complete task-level results.
